logdir.description: Directory where access and error logs are written.

docroot.description: Global default document root for static files when no virtual host matches.

listen.description: IP address to bind the primary listener to (e.g., '127.0.0.1', '::').

port.description: TCP port for the primary HTTP listener.

dir_listings.description: Allow directory listing when no index file is present.

user.description: Unix user account under which Yaws runs after startup (must exist).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent TCP connections allowed.

num_acceptors.description: Number of Erlang processes dedicated to accepting new connections.

servers.description: List of virtual hosts (server blocks) to configure. Each defines a distinct site.

name.description: Unique name for the virtual host (e.g., 'example.com').

listen.description: IP to bind this virtual host to.

port.description: Port for this virtual host (e.g., 8080 for alt HTTP).

ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 for this virtual host.

docroot.description: Document root specific to this virtual host.

dir_listings.description: Permit directory listing for this virtual host only (overrides global).

index_files.description: Ordered list of index files to try when a directory is requested.

extra_headers.description: Custom HTTP response headers to add (first header only supported by schema).

access_log.description: Path to per-vhost access log file.

error_log.description: Path to per-vhost error log file.

apps.description: List of embedded application handlers (e.g., SCGI/CGI backends).

scgi.description: Enable SCGI for this app handler.

cgi.description: Enable traditional CGI for this app handler.

extra_params.description: Key-value configuration for app (e.g., PHP-FPM socket settings).
